description: This is an ASP.NET Web Forms code-behind file for the AdminCourseQueue page in an online examination system. It handles page load events and button clicks to navigate between pages and manages a GridView selection event.

classes.name: AdminCourseQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminCourseQueue ASP.NET web page, managing navigation and user interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for when the page loads.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the home button is clicked, transferring user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for profile button click (currently no implementation).

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the event when the leaderboard button is clicked, transferring user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles logout button click, transferring user to the LoginPage.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection change in GridView2, storing selected row data in session and navigating to AdminCourseQueue.
